title: Install pre-commit validation hooks for work items
objective: Add ./scripts/install_sdlc_validate_git_hooks.mjs to install an idempotent Git pre-commit hook that validates every work item touched by a commit with sdlc work-item validate and prints the complete failure response before blocking invalid work-item commits.

branch.name: main
branch.rationale: The repository uses main for active work and the existing master release ref remains the release boundary.

request.text:
Prepare a new .docs/work-items/* to add ./scripts/install_sdlc_validate_git_hooks.mjs

The purpose is to invoke sdlc work-item validate any time we're committing changes to work items. The goal is to prevent invalid work item commits and display the response from sdlc validate upon failure to the terminal. This ensures an agent can't break the sdlc schemas or reference invariants.

As part of reviewing the work item, ensure sdlc work-item validate passes.

Commit the work item.

scope.name: hook-installer
scope.description: Add a Node.js installer at ./scripts/install_sdlc_validate_git_hooks.mjs that installs or updates the repository pre-commit hook without requiring an external hook manager.
scope.reason: The requested protection must be easy for an agent to install and use in this repository.

scope.name: staged-work-item-validation
scope.description: Have the pre-commit hook identify staged .docs/work-items/WI-* paths, validate each affected work item with sdlc work-item validate --work-item <id> --json, and allow unrelated commits without validation.
scope.reason: Only work-item changes need the schema/reference invariant gate, while normal source commits should retain existing workflow behavior.

scope.name: failure-response-and-safety
scope.description: Print the complete validation response to the terminal on failure, block the commit, preserve existing hook content, and make repeated installation idempotent.
scope.reason: Agents need actionable remediation context and the installer must not destroy repository-specific hooks.

scope.name: validation-and-review-gate
scope.description: Validate WI-0022 itself with sdlc work-item validate and add complete unit/integration coverage for installer and hook behavior.
scope.reason: The hook protects the same work-item/schema/reference invariants it must itself satisfy.

nonGoals.name: external-hook-manager
nonGoals.description: Do not add Husky, Lefthook, pre-commit, or another external hook framework dependency.
nonGoals.reason: The requested installer should work with the repository's existing Node.js tooling only.

nonGoals.name: remote-hook-installation
nonGoals.description: Do not install hooks globally, modify user-level Git configuration, or contact remote repositories.
nonGoals.reason: Installation is scoped to the current local repository.

nonGoals.name: automatic-work-item-repair
nonGoals.description: Do not repair or rewrite invalid work-item files from the hook; only report validation output and block the commit.
nonGoals.reason: The hook is a validation gate, not a migration or repair mechanism.

nonGoals.name: version-release
nonGoals.description: Do not bump package version or create a release/tag.
nonGoals.reason: The request is for repository hook protection, not a release.

items.name: installer-script
items.description: ./scripts/install_sdlc_validate_git_hooks.mjs must install a usable repository-local pre-commit hook using only confirmed Node.js/repository tooling.
items.reason: Agents need a repeatable installation boundary.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Running the installer creates or updates .git/hooks/pre-commit, makes it executable, and exits successfully.
Running the installer repeatedly is idempotent and preserves non-managed existing hook content.

items.name: staged-work-item-gate
items.description: The pre-commit hook must validate every work item whose files are staged for commit and skip commits with no staged work-item paths.
items.reason: The hook must prevent invalid work-item commits without unnecessarily blocking unrelated commits.

acceptanceCriteria.description: A staged .docs/work-items/WI-0022 change invokes sdlc work-item validate --work-item WI-0022 --json; multiple affected work items are each validated once.
A commit containing only non-work-item paths does not invoke work-item validation.

items.name: failure-terminal-response
items.description: When validation fails, the hook must print the complete sdlc validation JSON response to the terminal and return non-zero to block the commit.
items.reason: Coding agents need exact schema/reference findings for remediation.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The failure output includes the complete command response, affected work-item ID, object findings, reference findings, and remediation fields.
The hook blocks the commit after printing validation output and does not mutate the staged work-item files.

items.name: review-work-item-validation
items.description: WI-0022 must pass sdlc work-item validate --work-item WI-0022 before its work-item commit.
items.reason: The requested hook protects schema/reference invariants and must itself satisfy them.

acceptanceCriteria.description: sdlc work-item validate --work-item WI-0022 --json returns valid=true with zero invalid objects and zero unresolved references.

items.name: task-commit-test-gate
items.description: Every WI-0022 implementation and validation task must record and pass the complete unit-test command before its task commit.
items.reason: Hook installation, staged-file detection, subprocess output, permissions, idempotence, and failure blocking require continuous regression coverage.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Each task result records a passed full test execution and the repository suite is 100% passing at every task commit.
